title: Stop uploads from retrying forever
why: A failed upload now retries at most three times and then tells the user, so a broken file no longer keeps the queue busy all night.
chips: Users see a new error message

items.text: After the third failed try, the upload shows an error with a Retry button.

items.lead: The limit is fixed at three.
items.text: The issue asked for a setting. That moved to a later issue, listed under Changes from the plan.
